title: FDH Envelope state-transition table v0
description: Single source of truth for the Envelope state machine (frozen ADR 8061068 section 1.2). Loaded by tools/qa3/evidence/validate.py and tools/qa3/evidence/validate.ts; the same table feeds the Scheduler and Runner fixture checks.
notes: cancel_requested is the same meaning in the TaskStatus body and in the Envelope; a mismatch is rejected.
A report from an older epoch is rejected centrally (Scheduler), while an old Runner keeps its own external writes; external side effects are re-checked for ownership and approval by the Connector.
Terminal states have no outgoing transitions; re-opening a terminal Job requires a new Job, not a transition.
